task: Support optional jitter on Retry-After waits so a fleet does not retry simultaneously. Keep existing behavior by default and preserve server-requested delays and configured limits. Investigate the policy choices, implement the change and add regression tests.
requirements: retry_after_jitter defaults to zero and is additive uniform [0,value] only for positive Retry-After delays
Clamp the final delay to retry_after_max; never shorten the already-capped server delay
Missing, zero or expired Retry-After keeps existing fallthrough to exponential backoff
Reject negative, infinite and NaN jitter at construction; accept finite nonnegative numeric values
new() and increment() carry the setting
Document the option and provide a feature changelog fragment
